# agentmail_list (Resource)

One AgentMail allow or block list, for one direction of mail, owned whole by Terraform.

The resource is authoritative: an apply removes entries added outside Terraform. It adds entries before it removes any, so swapping entries never leaves a closed allow list empty, and so open.

~> **An allow list blocks every address it does not match from its first entry on.** Destroying an allow list, or emptying `entries`, removes its entries and so allows every address again. Changing an entry's `reason` deletes and re-adds the entry, because entries can't be updated; for an allow list whose only entry that is, the list is briefly open.

Reply lists are checked instead of receive lists for replies, and the most specific scope with a match wins: inbox, then pod, then organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Accept mail and replies only from known senders. The same entries close
# both lists, because replies are checked against the reply list instead of
# the receive list.
locals {
  partners = [
    { entry = "example.com", reason = "partner" },
    { entry = "alice@example.org" },
  ]
}

resource "agentmail_list" "support_allow" {
  for_each = toset(["receive", "reply"])

  inbox_id  = agentmail_inbox.support.inbox_id
  direction = each.key
  list_type = "allow"
  entries   = local.partners
}

# Block sending to a domain from every inbox in the organization.
resource "agentmail_list" "no_competitors" {
  direction = "send"
  list_type = "block"
  entries   = [{ entry = "competitor.example", reason = "policy" }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `direction` (String) `send`, `receive` or `reply`.
- `entries` (Attributes Set) Every entry the list holds, apart from read-only ones. An empty set removes them all. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `list_type` (String) `allow` or `block`.

### Optional

- `inbox_id` (String) Manage this inbox's list.
- `pod_id` (String) Manage this pod's list. Leave both `pod_id` and `inbox_id` unset for the organization's list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `inbox/<inbox_id>/<direction>/<list_type>`, `pod/<pod_id>/<direction>/<list_type>` or `org/<direction>/<list_type>`. Import a list by it.
- `read_only_entries` (Set of String) Entries AgentMail marks read-only. They can't be deleted through the API, so the resource leaves them alone.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `entry` (String) An email address, or a domain, which matches only itself and not its subdomains.

Optional:

- `reason` (String) Why the entry is there.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A list is imported by its scope, direction and list type.
terraform import 'agentmail_list.support_allow["receive"]' inbox/support@agentmail.to/receive/allow
terraform import agentmail_list.pod_block pod/pod_123/receive/block
terraform import agentmail_list.no_competitors org/send/block
```
